caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, vertical brown object centered on an off-white or light beige background. The object measures 11 3/4 inches in height and 7 inches in width, as indicated by hand-drawn black measurement marks and numbers along its sides. The surface of the rectangle features a decorative pattern made up of symmetrical spirals and arched lines, all composed of regularly spaced small white or light dots. The design includes four main spiral shapes—two near the top, two near the bottom—each mirrored left and right of a central vertical line that runs through the object. There are additional dotted curved and arched motifs framing the spirals. The artist’s name, "Geoffrey Holt," is written in small hand-lettered black ink at the bottom right corner of the drawing. There are some small, faint brown stains and marks toward the top of the background.
title: Pierced Metal Screen Inside Confessional
